note_zh: 十二张场景卡的机读形式。本文件是唯一真源：proposal.md 与 proposal.en.md 中的卡表由 analysis/build_scenario_cards.py 从本文件同一份数据生成，两者不一致时构建失败。校验器为 visual/assets/check_cards.js，它不接受本文件对自己的任何结论。
note_en: The twelve scenario cards in machine-readable form. This file is the single source: the card tables in both proposal editions are generated from it, and the build fails if they diverge. The reader is visual/assets/check_cards.js, which accepts none of this file's conclusions about itself.
privacy_boundary_shared_zh: 适用全部十二张卡：仅使用公开或已获授权的数据；不建立针对可识别个人的画像；不进行未经告知的持续跟踪；任何对个人产生法律或重大生活影响的判断必须由具备资格的人作出并留痕；每个场景必须存在一条无AI的等价服务路径。以上边界不可通过运营调整豁免。
privacy_boundary_shared_en: Applies to all twelve cards: only public or authorised data; no profiles of identifiable individuals; no undisclosed continuous tracking; any judgement with legal or major life effect on a person is made by a qualified person and logged; every scenario keeps an equivalent non-AI path. None of these may be waived by operational adjustment.

F1.applies_to_en: bodily safety or an administrative determination

classification.zh: 1 − 各站对同一问题结论的一致性比率
classification.en: 1 minus the ratio of stations reaching the same conclusion on the same question

service.zh: 各站满意度读数的极差
service.en: the range of satisfaction readings across the stations

safety_incident_count.definition_zh: 同时满足三条即计一起：(a) 设备与人体或车辆发生接触，或设备急停致第三方跌倒；(b) 事件发生时设备处于自主模式；(c) 现场或远程未在 2 秒内完成接管。仅系统告警、仅路径重规划、接管成功且无接触的，不计。
safety_incident_count.definition_en: All three must hold: (a) the device contacts a person or vehicle, or a device stop causes a third party to fall; (b) the device was in autonomous mode; (c) neither on-site nor remote takeover completed within 2 seconds. An alert alone, a re-plan alone, or a successful takeover without contact does not count.

misleading_output_count.definition_zh: 经执业人员书面认定为可能延误就医或导致错误用药的输出，每条计一起。
misleading_output_count.definition_en: Any output a licensed practitioner certifies in writing as liable to delay care or cause incorrect medication use; each counts as one.

breakpoint_false_positive_rate.definition_zh: 现场人工核验不成立的断点数 / 系统上报断点总数，按周期计。
breakpoint_false_positive_rate.definition_en: Reported breakpoints not confirmed on site, over all reported breakpoints, per cycle.

service_error_rate.definition_zh: 经复核认定为错误的答复数 / 抽查答复总数，按周期计；抽查比例与抽样方法须公示。
service_error_rate.definition_en: Replies found wrong on review, over all sampled replies, per cycle; the sampling rate and method are published.

authorisation_chain_break_count.definition_zh: 任一在流通环节的数据项缺少可追溯的上游授权记录，计一起。
authorisation_chain_break_count.definition_en: Any circulating data item lacking a traceable upstream authorisation record counts as one.

copyright_dispute_count.definition_zh: 收到权利人书面异议，计一起；异议不成立经核验后销案，不改变已下架期间的记录。
copyright_dispute_count.definition_en: A written objection from a rights holder counts as one; an objection later found unfounded is closed but does not erase the record of the takedown period.

historical_error_count.definition_zh: 经史实审校方书面认定的事实性错误陈述，每条计一起；表述争议不计。
historical_error_count.definition_en: A factual misstatement certified in writing by the historical reviewer; each counts as one. Disputes over phrasing do not count.

complaint_rate.definition_zh: 有效投诉件数 / 服务人次，按周期计；有效性由第三方而非运营方判定。
complaint_rate.definition_en: Upheld complaints over service instances, per cycle; validity is determined by a third party, not by the operator.

participation_rate.definition_zh: 实到人次 / 报名人次，按期计；仅聚合计数，不记录身份信息。
participation_rate.definition_en: Attendance over registrations, per edition; aggregate counts only, no identity data.

automated_execution_count.definition_zh: 系统在无人工决定留痕的情况下触发任何处置动作，计一起。
automated_execution_count.definition_en: The system triggering any disposition action with no logged human decision counts as one.

boundary_breach_count.definition_zh: 受测设备越过已公示的测试边界，计一起。
boundary_breach_count.definition_en: A device under test crossing the published test boundary counts as one.

user_override_count.definition_zh: 同一路段连续两期由使用者本人现场判定与系统结论相反，计一次。
user_override_count.definition_en: The same segment judged by the affected user in person, contrary to the system, in two consecutive cycles, counts as one.
